title: Engineering a Bilayered Hydrogel to Control ASC Differentiation
protocol: Isolate rat perirenal and epididymal adipose tissue.
Wash the isolated tissue with sterile Hank's buffered salt solution containing 1% fetal bovine serum.
Mince the tissue and transfer 1-2 g into a 50-mL tube with 25 mL of HBSS containing 1% FBS.
Centrifuge the mixture at 500 g for 8 min at room temperature.
Transfer the free-floating adipose tissue layer to a 125-mL Erlenmeyer flask and treat with 25 mL of collagenase type II in HBSS for 45 min at 37 °C on an orbital shaker (125 rpm).
Carefully remove the liquid fraction below the oil and adipose layer by pipetting.
Filter the removed liquid sequentially through a 100-μm and 70-μm nylon mesh filter.
Centrifuge the filtrate at 500 g for 10 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant and wash the cell pellet twice with 25 mL of HBSS.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 50 mL of growth medium supplemented with MesenPRO RS Growth Supplement, antibiotic-antimycotic, and L-glutamine.
Pipette cells into two T75 flasks (25 mL/flask).
Culture ASCs in a 5% CO2-humidified incubator at 37 °C.

Prepare CSMs by emulsifying an aqueous solution of chitosan (6 mL of 3%w/v chitosan in 0.5 M acetic acid) in a 100 mL oil phase mixture consisting of soya oil and n-octanol (1:2 v/v) with 5% sorbitan-mono-oleate emulsifier.
Use overhead stirring at 1700 rpm and magnetic stirring at 1000 rpm simultaneously but in opposite directions to ensure micelles remain in solution.
Stir the mixture continuously for approximately 1 hour until a stable water-in-oil emulsion is obtained.
Add 1.5 mL of 1% w/v potassium hydroxide in n-octanol every 15 min for 4 hours (total 24 mL) to initiate and complete ionic cross-linking.
After completion of the cross-linking reaction, slowly decant the oil phase containing CSM and immediately add 100 mL of acetone.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Decant and add an additional 100 mL of acetone.
Incubate overnight at room temperature.
Re-wash the beads with acetone for five minutes the next day.
Repeat washing until the solution is clear.
Dry the recovered spheres in a vacuum desiccator and analyze without further processing.
Wash the CSM three times with sterile water to remove residual salts.
Sterilize by washing overnight with 5 mL of absolute ethanol.
Incubate 5 mg of microspheres with 1 mL of 0.5% TNBS solution in a 50-mL glass tube for 4 h at 40 °C.
Hydrolyze with the addition of 3 mL of 6N HCl at 60 °C for 2 h.
Cool the samples to room temperature.
Add 5 mL of deionized water and 10 mL of ethyl ether to extract free TNBS.
Warm a 5-mL aliquot of the aqueous phase to 40 °C in a water bath for 15 min.
Evaporate any residual ether from the warmed sample.
Cool the sample to room temperature and dilute with 15 mL of water.
Measure the absorbance at 345 nm using TNBS solution without chitosan as blank.
Estimate the number of free amino groups of CSM relative to chitosan.
Equilibrate 5 mg of sterilized CSMs in sterile HBSS overnight.
Add equilibrated CSMs to an 8-μm pore size membrane culture plate insert (24-well plate).
Aspirate HBSS from the CSMs after settling.
Add 300 μL of growth medium to the inside and 700 μL to the outside of the insert.
Resuspend ASCs at appropriate concentration in 200 μL of growth medium.
Seed resuspended ASCs over the CSM inside the culture plate insert.
Incubate the ASC seeded on CSMs for 24 h in a 5% CO₂ humidified incubator at 37 °C.
Incubate ASC-loaded CSM in a sterile 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube without disturbing migrated cells.
Remove residual medium and add 250 μL of fresh growth medium to the tube.
Add 25 μL of MTT solution (5 mg/mL) to each tube.
Incubate for 4 h in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator at 37 °C.
Remove the medium after incubation.
Add 250 μL of dimethyl sulfoxide to the mixture.
Vortex the mixture for 2-5 min to solubilize the formazan complex.
Centrifuge the CSM at 2700 g for 5 min.
Pipette off the supernatant.
Determine the wavelength absorbance of the supernatant at 570 nm and 630 nm using a standard plate reader, according to MTT manufacturer's specifications.
Determine the cell number associated with the CSMs relative to the values obtained from defined ASC numbers cultured to develop a standard curve.
Mix 500 μl of fibrinogen stock (40 mg/mL in TBS, pH 7.8) and 250 μl of PEG stock in a culture well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate the mixture for 20 minutes in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator at 37°C.
Mix 250 μl of ASC-CSM with the PEGylated fibrinogen solution.
Immediately add 1 ml of thrombin stock (25U/mL) to the cell-fibrinogen mixture and trititate once or twice.
Place the cell-gel mixture in a 12-well plate and incubate at 37°C for 10 minutes to allow complete gelation.
Wash PEG-fibrin gels twice with HBSS.
Incubate the PEG-fibrin gels with α-MEM supplemented with 10% FBS in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator at 37°C.
Observe cell migration from CSM into the gel over an 11-day period using standard light microscopy techniques.
Mix ASC-CSM (5 mg containing ≈ 2 × 10^4 cells) with type 1 collagen (7.5 mg/mL).
Adjust the pH of the mixture to 6.8 using 2N NaOH.
Fibrillate the collagen-ASC-CSM mixture.
Add the fibrillated collagen-ASC-CSM mixture to a 12-well plate.
Incubate for 30 min in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator at 37°C.
Observe the migration of cells from CSM into the gel over an 11-day period using standard microscopy techniques.
Prepare a 1-mL type 1 collagen mixture without adding ASC-CSM.
Place the collagen mixture in a 6-well tissue culture insert and incubate for 30 min in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator at 37°C.
Layer 5 mg of ASC-CSM suspended in culture media over the fibrillated collagen surface.
Prepare the PEG-fibrin gel as described, without adding ASC-CSM to the mixture.
Layer the PEGylated fibrinogen/thrombin solution over the ASC-CSM-collagen layers.
Incubate the constructs for 30 min in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator at 37°C to achieve complete gelation.
Place 1 ml of medium in the upper chamber and 3 ml of medium in the lower chamber over the construct after gelation.
Dissolve 588.4 mg of CaCl2.2H2O with 100 ml of deionized water to make a calcium chloride stock solution (40 mM).
Sterilize the calcium chloride stock solution using a 0.22-μm filter.
Accurately weigh 32 mg of PEG in a nitrogen-purged 2-ml centrifuge tube and store at -80°C until use.
Dissolve 32 mg of PEG in 4 mL of TBS solution before use.
Prepare 15 ml of TBS solution by dissolving one buffer tablet in filter-sterilized deionized water and adjusting to pH 7.75-7.77 at 25°C.
Dissolve fibrinogen powder in TBS to make a concentration of 40 mg/ml.
Dissolve the entire quantity of fibrinogen overnight using a magnetic stirrer at 4°C.
Warm fibrinogen solution until homogenous in a water bath and filter sterilize with a 0.45-μm filter.
Weigh out thrombin and dissolve with prepared 200 mM CaCl2.2H2O to make the thrombin solution.
Aliquot and store thrombin solution at -20°C.
Load adipose-derived stem cells (ASCs) onto chitosan microspheres.
Pour collagen into a 6-well insert.
Adjust the pH of the collagen to induce fibrillation.
Place the 6-well insert containing the collagen and ASC-loaded CSM spheres into a 6-well plate chamber.
Layer the ASC-loaded CSM spheres over the collagen in the insert.
Pour PEGylated fibrinogen over the collagen-ASC-CSM layer in the insert.
Gel the PEGylated fibrinogen by adding thrombin.
Remove the final bilayer construct from the culture insert for further analysis.
